best_idea: A lock-on target held for a fixed grace time after its last hit, refreshed on every hit and dropped only when the timer runs out, so a brief look-away does not lose it.
decision_why: Keep the grace-timer hold as client-side lock-on forgiveness for the target frame; replace the donor's first-match pick with nearest-in-reach; restrict the attack-held gate to non-combat prompts. The hold is client input and HUD only, and the server still verifies every hit.
acceptance: When the aim slides off an enemy for under 0.3 s in a fight, the target frame stays on that enemy and the next attack goes to it; after 0.3 s with no hit the frame drops; a server test asserts the hit is still checked against the target's position at the time of the hit.
